notes: Director's cut for U1-E2 'The Collision' (script v4, Maya+Marcus). 16 scenes, ~446s estimated — durations are estimates at ~150 WPM; re-fit to real Fish TTS turn durations at render. Visual grammar: key-term KeywordPops land on the spoken term (Gold/God/Glory, Tordesillas, Oct 12 1492, Columbian Exchange, encomienda); RouteSlide for Columbus; CompareSlide for the two-way exchange; StatSlide for the 90% mortality; QuoteSlide for the closing tagline. No blank backgrounds — every text slide carries a contextual image or the textured default. Eyes-closed-safe: visuals echo, never carry.

steps: **Tordesillas, 1494** — the line: west to Spain, east to Portugal. That's why Brazil speaks Portuguese.
**Columbian Exchange** — crops cross both ways; disease sails west and kills most in the worst-hit places.
**Encomienda** — Spanish grants of Native labor. Brutal in practice; Las Casas blows the whistle.
